name: Tạo TVC quảng cáo phân bón MuseAI
description: TVC quảng cáo phân bón 2 bước: (1) ChatGPT ghép ảnh sản phẩm vào layout mong muốn thành ảnh quảng cáo hoàn chỉnh; (2) MuseAI (Meta) dựng video TVC dọc từ ảnh hoàn chỉnh đó. Cần đăng nhập ChatGPT và Muse trong Profile trình duyệt

variables.label: Tên sản phẩm (đúng như in trên bao bì)
Lợi ích chính
variables.default: cây xanh tốt, ra rễ mạnh, đậu trái nhiều

variables.label: Câu thoại / slogan trong video
variables.default: Dùng BOSS 1 – cây khỏe, mùa bội thu!

variables.label: Lời kêu gọi cuối video
variables.default: Liên hệ đại lý gần nhất

attachments.label: Ảnh sản phẩm (bao bì rõ nhãn)
attachments.hint: Ảnh bao / xô / chai phân bón chụp rõ logo và chữ trên nhãn
attachments.prompt: the exact product to place into the scene — keep its packaging, logo, label text, colors and proportions identical

attachments.label: Layout mong muốn (ảnh hoặc video mẫu)
attachments.hint: Ảnh quảng cáo mẫu có bố cục, bối cảnh, người mẫu bạn muốn — video sẽ được cắt 1 khung hình
attachments.prompt: follow its composition, background, people, lighting, camera angle and text placement

prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 Vietnamese TV commercial (TVC) for a fertilizer product, about 10 seconds, realistic cinematic advertising style.
Use the finished advertising image as the opening frame and the main look of the whole video: keep the same scene, people, lighting, colors and composition.
The product is {TenSanPham}. Its packaging, logo, label text, colors and proportions must stay exactly like the product photo in every frame — never redraw or misspell the label.
Story (smooth, continuous motion — no static slideshow):
- 0–3s: gentle camera push-in on the scene; the person presents {TenSanPham} proudly.
- 3–7s: show the benefit: {LoiIch} — healthy green crops, strong roots, plenty of fruit, warm natural sunlight.
- 7–10s: hero shot of {TenSanPham} in the foreground; the person smiles at the camera.
End with the call to action: “{CTA}”
Audio: upbeat advertising music with light countryside ambience.
Text: minimal, large and readable Vietnamese; no extra logos, no watermark.
Avoid: deformed hands, duplicated people, distorted product packaging, wrong or misspelled label text.

image_steps.label: Ghép sản phẩm vào layout (ChatGPT)
prompt: Create ONE photorealistic vertical 9:16 advertising image for the fertilizer product {TenSanPham}.
Recreate the layout reference: same composition, background, people (pose, outfit, expression), lighting, colors and camera angle.

Replace the product shown in the layout with the EXACT product from the product photo: identical packaging shape, logo, label text, colors and proportions. Do not redraw, translate or misspell the label.
Blend the product naturally into the scene: correct scale, perspective, shadows, reflections and hand contact if a person is holding it.
If the layout has a headline or speech bubble, write this Vietnamese text exactly: “{CauThoai}”. Otherwise add no text.
Sharp, clean, high-quality commercial photo. No watermark, no extra logos, no extra people, no distorted hands.

inputs.prompt: keep this composition, background, people, lighting and camera angle
place exactly this product into the scene — packaging, logo, label text and colors unchanged

video_inputs.prompt: use it as the opening frame and keep its scene, people and look throughout the video
the product packaging and label must look exactly like this in every frame
